screens.name: Sidebar navigation — inactive item colour fails AA contrast
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — NAPDDR State-Level Committee as a representative frame.

findings.element: Sidebar navigation — inactive item colour fails AA contrast
findings.figma: Inactive nav items are Neutral/Source #1f2937 on white (15.9:1). The active item is Primary/Source #003366.
findings.live: Inactive nav items compute to #9ca3af on #ffffff — a contrast ratio of 2.54:1, below the WCAG 2.1 AA minimum of 4.5:1 for body text. Measured on 488 nav links across every authenticated screen; opacity is 1 and pointer-events are auto, so this is the intended resting style, not a disabled state.
findings.fix: Set inactive sidebar links to Neutral/Source #1f2937 (or Neutral/600 #4b5563 at minimum, 7.0:1). Reserve #9ca3af for genuinely disabled items, which must also carry aria-disabled.

screens.name: GIGW masthead accessibility toolset reduced and relocated to a floating widget
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — NAPDDR State-Level Committee as a representative frame.

findings.element: GIGW masthead accessibility toolset reduced and relocated to a floating widget
findings.figma: The government masthead carries the mandated inline toolset: A− / A / A+ text sizing, a contrast toggle, an accessibility (person) icon, and a labelled 'English ▾' language selector with a globe icon.
findings.live: The masthead keeps A− / A / A+ and the contrast toggle but drops the accessibility icon, and the language selector is reduced to an unlabelled glyph. The accessibility options are moved into a floating circular widget pinned bottom-right (#9161ff, radius 70px).
findings.fix: Restore the full inline toolset in the masthead per GIGW, and trigger the accessibility panel from the masthead's accessibility icon rather than a floating button. Give the language selector a visible label.

findings.element: Filter controls built as rectangular selects instead of the designed filter pills
findings.figma: Filters are pill-shaped buttons with a leading chevron and a rounded 8px radius — 'All District ▾', 'Uttar Pradesh ▾' and a 'Date Range' button with a calendar icon.
findings.live: Filters render as rectangular native-style select boxes plus a separate date-range input, in a different control family from the design.
findings.fix: Rebuild the filter row with the designed pill control (8px radius, chevron affordance, Noto Sans 14px) so filters read as one component family across list screens.

findings.element: Danger red used for the non-destructive Clear-Filters control
findings.figma: No danger-coloured control appears in the filter row; clearing filters is a neutral, low-emphasis action.
findings.live: The clear-filters control is rendered in Danger red (#d64539 family, 50 elements across 5 screens), which signals a destructive action to the user.
findings.fix: Restyle clear-filters as a neutral tertiary control; reserve Danger/Source for genuinely destructive actions such as delete.

findings.element: Pagination loses its previous/next affordance
findings.figma: Pagination reads '‹ 1 2 3 4 5 6 … 150 ›' with chevron previous and next controls at each end.
findings.live: Pagination renders '1 2 3 … 3,19,399 +' — the chevrons are replaced by a '+' glyph and there is no previous control.
findings.fix: Restore the chevron previous/next controls and the truncated page range per the design.

findings.element: Breadcrumb trail not rendered
findings.figma: A breadcrumb sits above the page title: 'Home › State-Level Steering and Monitoring Committee', with the trailing crumb in Primary/Source.
findings.live: No breadcrumb is rendered; the page title is the first element in the content column.
findings.fix: Add the breadcrumb above the page title on the committee screens, matching the design's separator and active-crumb colour.

findings.element: 'All States' filter missing beside the search field
findings.figma: The toolbar row carries the search field plus an 'All States ▾' filter control aligned right.
findings.live: Only the search field is rendered; the filter control is absent, so the list cannot be narrowed by state.
findings.fix: Show all the relevant filters — add the States filter to the toolbar row per the design.

findings.element: 'My Submissions' table section not built on the dashboard
findings.figma: Below the KPI row the dashboard carries a full 'My Submissions' panel — search field, All Location and All Activity filter pills, a six-column table (Activity, Activity Date, Participants, Male, Female, View) and pagination showing 5 of 1500 items.
findings.live: The dashboard ends after the KPI cards; no submissions panel is rendered. The equivalent list exists on a separate route (State/UT/District Dashboard).
findings.fix: Add the My Submissions panel to the dashboard per the design, or confirm the decision to move it to State/UT/District Activity and update the design.

findings.element: Primary 'Submit Activity' action absent from the dashboard header
findings.figma: A navy primary button 'Submit Activity' sits top-right, aligned with the page title.
findings.live: No primary action is rendered in the dashboard header; the page title row is empty on the right.
findings.fix: Add the primary 'Submit Activity' button to the dashboard header, or confirm the action now lives only on State/UT/District Activity.

findings.element: KPI cards lost their trend indicator
findings.figma: Each KPI card carries a value and a trend line beneath it — an up/down arrow with '+14.5% vs last month' in Success or Danger.
findings.live: KPI cards render the label, icon and value only; no trend line appears on any card.
findings.fix: Restore the trend row on each KPI card using Text/Success #2e7d32 and Text/Error #ec5042 for positive and negative deltas.

findings.element: KPI grid reflows to unequal card widths
findings.figma: Three equal-width KPI cards in a single row, with equal gaps.
findings.live: Five cards wrap across two rows (3 + 2) and the cards do not share a common width — the second card in row one is visibly wider than its neighbours.
findings.fix: Lay the KPI row out on a uniform grid so every card shares one column width and the last row aligns to the same tracks.

screens.name: Sidebar navigation icons absent portal-wide
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — NAPDDR State-Level Committee as a representative frame.

findings.element: Sidebar navigation icons absent portal-wide
findings.figma: Every sidebar item is preceded by a Material Symbols Rounded icon at 24px, weight Light, Primary/Source #003366 (e.g. account_balance on the NAPDDR group).
findings.live: No icon is rendered against any sidebar item; items are text-only with a tree-line connector. The extraction finds zero Material Symbols elements anywhere in the build.
findings.fix: Render the Material Symbols Rounded icon for each nav item at 24px / weight 300–Light, and load the icon font once in the root layout.

screens.name: Page title (H1) is off the type scale and inconsistent between screens
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: Page title (H1) is off the type scale and inconsistent between screens
findings.figma: One page-title role: Headline/headline-3 — 24px, SemiBold (600), Neutral/Source #1f2937. The NAPDDR screens use Display/display-5 — 28px, Medium.
findings.live: Four different treatments across the build: 24px/600/#111827, 24px/700/#374151, 24px/600/#1f2937 and 32px/600/#374151. Neither #111827 nor #374151 is a token in the NMBA palette.
findings.fix: Bind every page title to one token — font-size 24px, weight 600, colour #1f2937 — and use 28px Medium only where the design specifies Display/display-5.

screens.name: Non-brand typefaces rendering instead of Noto Sans
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: Non-brand typefaces rendering instead of Noto Sans
findings.figma: font-family/body and font-family/heading are both Noto Sans — the mandated DBIM typeface for all government properties.
findings.live: Poppins renders on 63 elements across 23 screens (search fields and filter controls), -apple-system on 25 elements across 9 screens, and Lucida Console on 8 across 3.
findings.fix: Remove the Poppins and system-font declarations so every control inherits Noto Sans; confirm the Noto Sans webfont is preloaded so no fallback is ever painted.

screens.name: Government masthead lockup drops its third line and inverts the emphasis
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: Government masthead lockup drops its third line and inverts the emphasis
findings.figma: A three-line lockup beside the National Emblem: 'Government of India' (12px), 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment' (12px), then 'Department of Social Justice & Empowerment' as the emphasised bold navy line.
findings.live: A two-line lockup: 'Government of India' (12px) then 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment' set as the emphasised line at 20px/700/#374151. The Department line is absent and the emblem is rendered noticeably larger.
findings.fix: Restore the three-line lockup with the Department name as the emphasised line, and match the emblem size and baseline alignment to the design.

screens.name: Sidebar navigation label size larger than the design
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — NAPDDR State-Level Committee as a representative frame.

findings.element: Sidebar navigation label size larger than the design
findings.figma: Nav labels are Label/label-1 — 14px, Regular.
findings.live: Nav labels compute to 16px, weight 400 (488 elements), and the active item is weight 700 where the design distinguishes the active state by colour alone.
findings.fix: Set sidebar labels to 14px Regular; express the active state with Primary/Source #003366 and the selected background, not a weight jump to 700.

screens.name: Corner-radius drift across buttons and controls
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: Corner-radius drift across buttons and controls
findings.figma: button-corner = 8px; the radius ramp is 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 999.
findings.live: Alongside the 8px token (1,745 controls) the build also renders radius 12 (924), 0 (839), 10 (47), 6 (11) and 70 (66). Radius 10 alone appears on 310 elements across all 36 screens; 10 and 70 are not on the ramp at all.
findings.fix: Bind control radii to the token ramp — 8px for buttons and inputs, 12px for cards — and replace the 10px and 70px values with radius-md/radius-lg or radius-full.

screens.name: Off-token neutral greys, including pure black
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: Off-token neutral greys, including pure black
findings.figma: The neutral ramp is #f9fafb / #f3f4f6 / #e5e7eb / #d1d5db / #6b7280 / #4b5563 / #374151 / #1f2937. Pure black is not in the palette.
findings.live: #000000 renders on 696 elements across all 36 screens and #9ca3af on 635. #212121 appears on 612 (accessibility-bar chrome).
findings.fix: Replace #000000 with Neutral/Source #1f2937 and #9ca3af with Neutral/500 #6b7280, and bring the accessibility-bar chrome onto the neutral ramp.

screens.name: Table column headers use two different weights
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — NAPDDR State-Level Committee as a representative frame.

findings.element: Table column headers use two different weights
findings.figma: Column headers are a single role — 14px Medium, Neutral/500 #6b7280.
findings.live: Headers render 14px/600 on 174 cells and 14px/500 on 114, so weight varies between list screens. Colour (#6b7280) and the transparent header background are correct.
findings.fix: Set every table column header to 14px weight 500, colour #6b7280.

screens.name: BETA badge set below the smallest step of the type scale
screens.note: Applies to every screen that renders this element. Shown against Admin — All Pledge Report as a representative frame.

findings.element: BETA badge set below the smallest step of the type scale
findings.figma: The smallest role is Label/label-3 — 11px.
findings.live: The BETA badge renders at 10px on 47 screens.
findings.fix: Raise the BETA badge to 11px (Label/label-3).
